en.askTitle: Swap in your own passport, income and savings and see which remote-work visas you actually fit before you apply
en.runTitle: US freelance designer, five remote-work visa routes, leaving in March 2027

fields.label: Countries
fields.value: Portugal (D8), Spain, Thailand (DTV), Indonesia/Bali (E33G), Mexico (temporary residence)

fields.label: Employment or business structure, clients, company age, remote terms, degree and experience
fields.value: Freelance UX designer with overseas clients

fields.label: Personal paid income (gross and net) and history
fields.value: About USD 5,500 a month from overseas clients

fields.label: Liquid savings and monthly minimum balances
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 20,000 in savings, never below USD 12,000 in the last 3 months

en.template: Compare {countries} for {passport}, leaving {date}, with {stays}. My work is {work}; personal paid gross/net income is {income}, not turnover, and liquid savings/monthly minimums are {savings}. Give a shortlist and backward plan. Separate financial tests, full eligibility, visitor entry, work/local-client rights, social security, insurance and tax. Use primary sources. Keep conflicting consular figures and source dates; distinguish enacted rules, announcements, projections, selective rereads, failed access and older information. Separate alternative routes, stay/entry/extension/card stages, future fees, extras and document validity. Do not promise approval, 2027 rules or tax exemptions, or create accounts, contact officials, apply, pay, book, submit or publish.

phases.title: Research five visa programmes and tax-residency rules from official sources
phases.note: Income and savings tests, fees, documents, insurance, work rights and tax risk per country
phases.judgment: Spain’s income figure was left as a conflict, not forced into one number. The consulate publishes EUR 2,442 a month, while a calculation from the 2026 wage decree gives EUR 2,849. Both are shown and labelled.

phases.title: Build the editable workbook and the phone-friendly summary, with sources and timeline
phases.note: Comparison table, fees, March 2027 timeline, tax-risk flags
phases.judgment: An independent check confirmed it was right not to call Bali a fit. USD 66,000 a year in income is not enough on its own: the official page also needs an employment agreement with a company outside Indonesia, so freelance eligibility is marked not established.

phases.title: Check the files, the eligibility conclusions and the finished page
phases.judgment: What it could not confirm (some fees, renewal details, 2027 changes) is flagged as unverified instead of estimated. The workbook’s 11 formulas and the phone-width page were checked.

workers: Read official Portugal and Spain pages on income thresholds, documents, fees and the extra rules for freelancers
Read official Thailand (DTV) and Indonesia (E33G) pages: savings and income tests, fees, insurance, renewals and tax-residency risk
Checked Mexico’s official consulate, immigration and tax sources
Independently spot-checked the research for eligibility conclusions that could be wrong, including freelancer rules and income tests

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的护照、收入和存款，申请前先看清自己真正符合哪些远程工作签证
zh.runTitle: 美国自由职业设计师比较五条远程工作签证路线，2027 年 3 月出发

fields.label: 国家
fields.value: 葡萄牙（D8）、西班牙、泰国（DTV）、印尼巴厘岛（E33G）、墨西哥（临时居留）

fields.label: 雇佣或企业结构、客户主体及国家、公司及合作年限、远程条款、学位经验
fields.value: UX 自由职业设计师，客户在海外

fields.label: 个人税前和税后实收收入及历史
fields.value: 每月约 5,500 美元，来自海外客户

fields.label: 流动储蓄和历史月最低余额
fields.placeholder: 例如：存款 2 万美元，近 3 个月最低余额不低于 1.2 万美元

zh.template: 请比较{countries}的远程工作途径：我持{passport}，从{residence}申请，{date}出发，各地停留和同行人{stays}。工作为{work}；个人税前和税后实收收入{income}，不是营业额，流动储蓄和历史月最低余额{savings}。给我候选和倒排计划，分清财务门槛、完整资格、访客入境、工作及本地客户权限、社保、保险和税务。使用一手来源。保留领馆数字冲突与来源日期，分清生效规则、公告、预测、选择性复查、读取失败和旧资料。分别列替代途径、停留及入境窗口、延期和办卡阶段、未来费用、附加支出和材料时效。不要承诺获批、2027规则或免税，也不要创建账户、联系官员、申请、付款、预订、提交或发布。

phases.title: 依据官方来源，调研五个签证项目和税务居民规则
phases.note: 各国的收入与存款要求、费用、材料、保险、工作权利和税务风险
phases.judgment: 西班牙的收入数字没有硬凑成一个，而是把冲突如实留着：领馆公布每月 2,442 欧元，按 2026 年最低工资法令折算则是 2,849 欧元。两个数都列出并分别标注。

phases.title: 建立可编辑的表格和适合手机看的摘要页，附来源和时间线
phases.note: 对比表、费用、2027 年 3 月出发时间线、税务风险提示
phases.judgment: 独立复核认可了不把巴厘岛算作“符合”的判断。年收入 6.6 万美元本身不够：官方页面还要求与印尼境外公司签的雇佣协议，所以自由职业者的资格被标为“未确认”。

phases.title: 检查文件、资格判断和做好的页面
phases.judgment: 没能确认的内容（部分费用、续期细节、2027 年变化）都标成“未核实”，没有估一个数字充数。表格里的 11 个公式和手机宽度下的页面也都检查过。

workers: 阅读葡萄牙和西班牙官方页面：收入门槛、材料、费用，以及对自由职业者的额外要求
阅读泰国（DTV）和印尼（E33G）官方页面：存款与收入要求、费用、保险、续期和税务居民风险
核查墨西哥领事、移民和税务方面的官方来源
独立抽查调研结论里可能出错的资格判断，包括自由职业者规则和收入要求
